تعانقت (form VI)
# تَعَانَقْتُ (taʕānaqtu) /ta.ʕaː.naq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
# تَعَانَقْتَ (taʕānaqta) /ta.ʕaː.naq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
# تَعَانَقْتِ (taʕānaqti) /ta.ʕaː.naq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
# تَعَانَقَتْ (taʕānaqat) /ta.ʕaː.na.qat/: third-person fem
